title: ETI ART RESIDENCY 2025
subtitle: Louhang Art Hill Project · Artist Residency Coordination & Project Administration
topic_badge: STAR CASE STUDY · 行为面试与项目管理 (原英文记忆)
core_hook: “Connect the artist's ideas and needs with local resources and people; anchor multi-stakeholder chaos with shared spreadsheet clarity.”

chunks.name: Pre-arrival Logistics & Material Discovery
chunks.cue_label: ACTIVE RECALL CUE / 主动回忆提问
chunks.overview_summary: Pre-arrival logistics (needs, materials, housing, transport), neighborhood visits, and discovering key material at a local veneer factory while recruiting workshop participants.
chunks.recall_prompt: What specific preparations did you make before Eti arrived, and how did you connect her artistic vision with local community materials and residents?
points: Communicated about what she needed in advance; prepared materials and tools, booked accommodation based on preferences, and arranged airport-to-residency transport.
Accompanied her on neighborhood visits during the first few days; visited a local veneer factory where she found the main material for her work.
Met local residents and invited them to participate, while recruiting additional participants via social media to bridge artist ideas with local people.
chunks.formula: “Prep Needs & Tools, Scout Veneer, Invite Residents”
chunks.analogy: Like planting a tree: prepare the ground in advance (logistics), then help roots latch directly onto native soil (veneer factory & local community).
chunks.practice_prompt: Verbal Recall Challenge: Without looking above, write down the 4 pre-arrival logistical steps and the exact English sentence describing your core role:
chunks.tip: * Tip: Cover the text above. Verbally recite Eti's name, the project, and the veneer factory in complete English sentences.
chunks.placeholder: Write your verbal recall notes here: (1) Pre-arrival 4 tasks... (2) Veneer factory visit... (3) Core role sentence: 'My role was really to connect...'

chunks.name: Solo Exhibition Delivery & Multi-Stakeholder Matrix
chunks.cue_label: ACTIVE RECALL CUE / 主动回忆提问
chunks.overview_summary: Delivered a solo exhibition as part of the art fair by synchronizing a 6-party stakeholder network and managing materials, staff, and schedules across 7 days.
chunks.recall_prompt: Who were the 6 stakeholders you coordinated to deliver the solo exhibition, and how did you manage the workshops and interviews during the 7-day art fair?
points: To deliver the exhibition, coordinated with: (1) Artist, (2) Visual Designer, (3) Installation Staff, (4) Community Volunteers, (5) Art Fair Organizer, and (6) Local Culture & Tourism Dept.
Managed several workshops and interviews during the seven-day art fair; coordinated materials, staff, and schedules for each workshop.
Collected information about each activity for social promotion and participant recruitment, ensuring seamless audience engagement.
chunks.formula: “6 Parties Aligned, 7 Days Anchored, Every Workshop Synced”
chunks.analogy: Like an orchestra conductor: the artist is the soloist, installation and design are the orchestra, culture/tourism sets the hall, and coordination keeps the tempo.
chunks.practice_prompt: Verbal Recall Challenge: Draw the 6-stakeholder network from memory and list the 3 operational items coordinated for each workshop (m___, s___, s___):
chunks.tip: * Tip: Recite all 6 stakeholders aloud in English without pause. Ensure smooth transitions between each role.
chunks.placeholder: Sketch the 6 stakeholders network here: Artist / Visual Designer / Installation Staff / Community Volunteers / Art Fair Organizer / Culture & Tourism Dept...

chunks.name: Shared Spreadsheet System & Complexity Management
chunks.cue_label: ACTIVE RECALL CUE / 主动回忆提问
chunks.overview_summary: Established a project administration system using shared spreadsheets tracking Done, Next, Owner, and Deadlines to maintain cross-functional alignment and order.
chunks.recall_prompt: How did your project administration system work, and how did it specifically keep this complicated project organized?
points: Used shared spreadsheets to clearly document: (1) what had already been done, (2) what needed to happen next, (3) who was responsible for each task, and (4) deadlines.
Kept all stakeholders and volunteers informed in real time, preventing misunderstandings, delays, and task duplication.
Transformed a high-stress, multi-threaded exhibition into an organized and resilient workflow: 'helped me keep a complicated project organized.'
chunks.formula: “Done, Next, Owner, Deadlines: 4 Pillars of Administrative Clarity”
chunks.analogy: Like Air Traffic Control (ATC): dozens of moving flights stay on track because the radar board strictly broadcasts status, route, owner, and precise time slots.
chunks.practice_prompt: Verbal Recall Challenge: Write down the 4 columns of your shared spreadsheet and draft your 30-second STAR interview closing statement in original English:
chunks.tip: * Tip: Practice delivering the final 2 sentences of the text aloud in English with confident body language.
chunks.placeholder: Practice writing the 4 columns: [Done] [Next] [Owner] [Deadline]. Then write your closing takeaway: 'This was where my project administration system became especially important...'

matrix.purpose: Bridge artist vision with local community & materials
matrix.mechanism: Pre-arrival logistics + neighborhood/veneer factory visits + dual recruitment
Synchronized 6 stakeholders + managed materials, staff, schedules for workshops
Shared spreadsheets tracking Done, Next, Owner, and Deadlines

blind_checklist.question: Can you immediately recite in English: Year (2025), Project (Louhang Art Hill), Residency Duration (one-month), Artist (Israeli artist Eti), Core Material (local veneer factory)?
Can you fluently say the key thesis sentence: 'My role was really to connect the artist's ideas and needs with the resources and people available locally'?
Can you name all 6 parties in English without hesitation: (1) Artist, (2) Visual Designer, (3) Installation Staff, (4) Volunteers, (5) Organizer, (6) Culture & Tourism Dept?
Can you recite the exact 4 spreadsheet items: 'what had already been done, what needed to happen next, who was responsible for each task, and the deadlines'?

pitfall: 面试高频避坑 (Interview Tip): 不要将这段经历讲成普通的接机后勤！请牢牢抓住两个英文核心原句去表达：① 'My role was really to connect the artist's ideas and needs with the resources and people available locally'；② 'This was where my project administration system became especially important: using shared spreadsheets to clearly document Done, Next, Owner, and Deadlines to keep a complicated project organized'。
